title: Arrest by National High-Tech Crime Unit

tellings.quote: I'm Jeff Donsson from the National High-Tech Crime Unit. You're under arrest for computer misuse.

plain: A British hacker named Gary McKinnon, who says he broke into NASA and military computers and found signs of a secret space program, says he was arrested in London in 2002. He recalls an officer introducing himself as Jeff Donsson from the National High-Tech Crime Unit, a British police unit for computer crime, and telling him he was under arrest for computer misuse. McKinnon tells it as the person who was arrested.
